author: Good Enough
description:
A severe hailstorm can become dangerous in seconds, especially when large hail starts falling at high speeds. Knowing where to take cover, how to protect your head, and what to do if you’re caught outside can greatly reduce your risk of serious injury.

This Short explains how to survive a hailstorm, what to do during giant hail, where to shelter, and the biggest mistakes to avoid during severe weather.
title: How to Survive a Deadly Hailstorm ⛈️⚠️ #naturaldisaster #survival #outdoors #storm

author: Good Enough
description:
HD 189733 b is one of the most extreme exoplanets ever discovered, a world where powerful winds may drive glass-like particles sideways through the atmosphere. This scorching blue planet has violent weather, intense heat, and supersonic winds that make its conditions far more hostile than anything on Earth.

The planet’s atmosphere contains silicate particles that can condense into tiny glass-like droplets, while winds moving thousands of miles per hour can whip them sideways across the planet. This Short explores HD 189733 b, sideways glass rain, extreme exoplanets, alien weather, violent winds, and some of the most terrifying planetary conditions ever discovered.
title: This Planet Rains Glass Sideways 🪐😰 #space #exoplanets #astronomy #galaxy
